per_candidate.id: s2:Emission Spectra of Galaxies with Supermassive Black Holes at z > 6
s2:Formation of Supermassive Stars and the Direct Collapse to Black Holes

rationale: The direct candidates provide evidence on the formation mechanisms and growth of black holes in the early Universe, including the role of Population III remnants, massive seeds, and super-Eddington accretion. However, the question remains partially addressed as the complete mechanisms and timescales are not fully resolved. Papers 1804.06477, 1810.12310, 2009.13505, 1807.06967, and 1811.04953 contribute substantive new evidence on different aspects of the question.
